schema.description: One UTC hour of heart rate, a slot a minute: 60 beats per minute, or null for a minute the watch recorded none. Beside health.heart-rate.day, which holds a day's resting, minimum and maximum as one fact, these are the watch's own readings, so a reader computes any window's figures from the slots and can see where the gaps are: nothing here is averaged and no bucket is kept. Garmin writes them through the anam_garmin importer (source garmin) from the watch's monitoring FIT files, whose timestamps are UTC by the format's definition, so a day is its 24 hours whatever zone the watch was in when it recorded them.

id.description: The hour's start in UTC, and the identity: one facet per UTC hour. Not prefixed: no other type of this source keys on an RFC 3339 instant, so it cannot be mistaken for one of them.

items.description: The watch's reading in that minute, in beats per minute, or null for a minute it recorded none.

bpm.description: The hour's beats per minute, one slot a minute: slot 0 is the hour's first minute, slot 59 its last. A number is the watch's reading in that minute, as it gave it and never averaged; null is a minute with no reading. A minute the watch sampled twice keeps the last sample. A Datalog query reads a slot as /bpm/0 through /bpm/59.

unit.description: Always beats/min: every slot in bpm is a heart rate in the same unit.

effective_time_frame.description: The hour the slots cover: its start, which is the fact time and the id, and its end, the next hour's start. Both are UTC, half-open: a sample at the end belongs to the next hour. A daylight-saving change moves no boundary here, since the hours are UTC's, not a zone's.

start_date_time.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, the hour's start.

end_date_time.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, the hour's end, exactly one hour after its start.

source_time.description: How the watch's time was read: value is the hour's start as it names it, read in UTC (basis source). A FIT timestamp is seconds from 1989-12-31T00:00:00Z by the format's definition, so the watch's own zone never enters it.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
